title: Universaarl Number Series Lines page inspection or alternative editor route
goal: Find a reliable standard Business Central route for Number Series Lines Startnr./Endnr. after coordinate and selected-cell typing failed.
successCriteria: The true page/table/field context for No. Series Lines is identified through UI inspection or a standard BC route.
If a write is attempted, Startnr./Endnr. values must be visible after blur/reopen before setup readiness is claimed.
Checkboxes such as Offen and Luecken in Nummern zulassen are inventoried and not changed without an explicit gate.
No setup assignment, master data, preview posting, posting or ledger trace occurs.
knownLearningFromTarget016C: Liste bearbeiten / Edit List can put the Number Series Lines grid into editable row mode.
BC grid selected cells are not enough evidence for a writable editor.
Coordinate/header and selected-cell typing can select labels/tooltips/page text instead of writing values.
Checkbox columns such as Offen and Luecken in Nummern zulassen are visible and must be documented before changing them.
nextSafeAction: Use Page Inspection/Personalize or another standard BC UI route; do not repeat coordinate or selected-cell typing.
